what: Maps failed CI job lint to make lint (or generic pre-commit) while CI runs SKIP=agnix,lint-mermaid-fences,shellcheck make lint-only

what: Edge case claims empty capture log yields ok via lint-fix-loop no-changes

suggested_fix: Revise helper contract rerun after dispatch treat no-changes plus failing rerun as exhausted or failed align with run_checks_with_lint_fix_loop

what: Drift pin greps ^ [a-z][a-z0-9_-]+:$ over whole ci.yaml
